chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 273: The Final Nexus – Illusion, Golems, and a Dangerous Feast
chapter_meta_description: Shao Yanong attempts to refine the last sub-hall nexus. An illusory formation with a mind behind it strikes, forcing Xiangliu Fang to brute-force a path. But a cunning golem leader is already plotting the killing blow.
og_title: The Last Sub-Hall: Illusory Formation & Golem Ambush
og_description: Xiangliu Fang crushes a controlled formation as Shao Yanong pushes for the final refinement. But the golem leader watches, waiting for the perfect strike.
twitter_title: Peach Blossom Illusion / Golem Strike Plan
twitter_description: Shao Yanong's confidence peaks as the final nexus nears, but a soul-driven golem commander has one hour to assassinate the young master.

lore_anchors.definition: The main hall of the Sorcerer River Immortal's estate; contains the final sub-hall nexus (a bronze lamp) needed to control the entire immortal mansion.
A type of magical array that traps victims in a fabricated sensory world; more complex ones can combine confusion with elemental attacks, such as the Azurewood Divine Thunder here.
A wood-element thunder technique generated by drawing solar power through a wood-based formation; a classic lethal hazard in immortal estate trials.
A powerful construct shaped after the mythical Qiongqi (a winged tiger-peril of Chinese legend). The leader golem here has a living soul trapped inside, granting it high tactical intelligence.

An artificial being crafted from materials and animated via seals or bound souls. In Xianxia, golems serve as eternal guardians; those with souls are far more adaptive and dangerous than simple automatons.
A powerful Fiendgod serving as Shao Yanong's chief bodyguard. Able to turn his hands and fingers into giant serpents to physically tear apart formations—a hallmark of brute-force Fiendgod combat.
A standard defensive formation using five cultivators to cover four cardinal directions plus the center, harmonizing their elemental alignments.
